description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Holy with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Invincible General Mode I (Celes - Holy)] and [Holy Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Invincible General Mode I (Celes - Holy)
description.text: Holy abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Holy abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00 for equipped Holy abilities, casts Dual Divine End after using equipped Holy abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [50% Critical (25s)], grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Invincible General Mode II (Celes - Holy)] to the user, removes Mode I from the user

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Invincible General Mode II (Celes - Holy)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap by 10000, Holy abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Holy abilities trigger 1 additional time, grants [Dual Unleashed Runic Blade 60% Critical]/[Dual Unleashed Runic Blade 80% Critical]/[Dual Unleashed Runic Blade 100% Critical] to all allies after using 1/2/3+ Holy abilities

description.name: Dual Divine End
description.text: Four single attacks (0.50 each), 100% hit rate

description.name: Attach Holy with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Holy Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Holy 3
